gff_transformations: Select complete features overlapping the source interval.
Replace seqid Chr1 with CEN1 and subtract 14841109 from coordinates.
Retain source IDs, source, feature type, strand, score, phase and attributes.
Set Length to end-start+1; retain its source value in OriginalLength.
Add OriginalSeqid, OriginalStart and OriginalEnd attributes.

simulation_initialization.method: Orient each feature by strand; trim excess bases from the biological 5-prime end; pad short features at the biological 3-prime end with the consensus suffix; retain genomic feature order.
simulation_initialization.telobox_bearing_monomers: Retained as present in the real reference; no replacement.

snp_inputs.spectrum_source: Centromeric SNPs from MA32-59, MA32-69, MA32-89 and MA32-119; 64 records, normalized per reference base.
